facts.value: The University Computer Center (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.) and offers advice and support for technical issues.
facts.programme_association: Fundamental Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The Telephone Hotline of Goethe University and the Student Secretariat help with questions related to applications, semester dates, re-enrollment, major changes, double studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation, among others.
facts.programme_association: Fundamental Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: International Student Services provide international students with information on 'residence permits', 'German courses', 'financing', 'studying successfully', 'careers', and much more. Additionally, they offer advice and support.
facts.programme_association: Fundamental Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The Student Union supports students in social and economic matters. It is committed to ensuring that students have the necessary infrastructure for successful study in areas such as education funding, student housing, and dining services.
facts.programme_association: Fundamental Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
